第7章斩杀曹勇，黑痕催天劫

信号符在天空中炸开的时候，刀疤脸曹勇正在山洞里生闷气。

他堂堂炼气八层执法队长被一个矿奴耍得团团转。

信号符炸开的方位不对——宋玉应该在山那边堵人，怎么焰火会从那个位置炸开？

除非宋玉已死，信号符是那矿奴放的。

“妈的！”

曹勇一拳砸在石壁上，“那小子在反猎！”

说出这句话时他自己都觉得荒谬。

一个矿奴没有修为凭什么反猎青云宗正规弟子？

但韩铁死了，赵虎死了，踏雪残了，现在宋玉也死了。

容不得他不信。

曹勇强迫自己冷静下来。

宋玉炼气六层护体灵气不算太厚，若对方用毒加陷阱确实可能得手。

但自己炼气八层，护体罡膜比宋玉浑厚至少五成以上，那小子就算用毒也未必能破防。

而且从之前几次交手来看，这小子每次杀人用的都是毒和陷阱——说明他正面战力有限，只能靠这些旁门左道。

“他现在是强弩之末。”

曹勇给自己打气，“杀宋玉肯定也费了不少力气。

只要我不中毒不踩陷阱，他就是个废物。”

他提刀走出山洞朝信号符炸开的方向走去，走得很慢，每一步都格外谨慎，口中含着解毒丹，地面每一处异常都仔细查看，树枝上的藤蔓先砍一刀试探。

但他不知道的是苏余根本没打算用陷阱对付他。

苏余站在一棵参天古树的树冠上，居高临下看着曹勇走近。

手中寒霜剑在月光下泛着幽冷寒光，怀里有那张炎爆符。

单凭寒霜剑破不了曹勇的护体罡膜——炼气八层罡膜比韩铁厚了不止一倍。

之前杀韩铁炼气四层尚且需要连斩四刀，曹勇的罡膜至少要七八刀，而他的一息绝对静止斩不出那么多刀。

但他有个想法。

炎爆符威力相当于炼气中期全力一击，若将它贴在寒霜剑剑柄末端引爆——火焰冲击力会将寒霜剑像弩箭一样推出去，穿透力远胜徒手刺击。

在绝对静止中引爆，剑尖对准曹勇罡膜最薄弱处，一击贯穿。

这是他爹教他的道理——猎户的箭矢靠弓弦发力，穿透力胜过徒手投掷十倍。

炎爆符就是他的弓弦，寒霜剑就是他的箭。

但这个想法有个致命的缺陷：炎爆符爆炸时他必须握剑，火焰冲击会同时伤到他。

他需要时间护盾——但那要消耗三十息寿命和一道黑痕。

五道变六道，他犹豫了。

或者他可以用时间静止在极小范围内精确控制爆炸时机，在炎爆符炸开的瞬间松开手，让冲击力只作用于剑柄。

但这需要极高的精确度，他只有五成把握。

六道就六道。

现在不用等曹勇叫来更多同门，想用都没机会了。

曹勇走到一处相对开阔的林间空地停住脚步环顾四周，神识铺开。

“出来吧！

你放了信号符不就是为了引我来吗？

现在我来了你反倒躲起来？”

树冠上苏余无声笑了笑。

他在等一击必杀的机会。

曹勇越来越烦躁在空地上来回踱步。

苏余握紧寒霜剑，从怀中取出炎爆符。

他没有将符贴在剑柄上——那样爆炸时冲击力会四散。

Chapter 7: Killing Cao Yong, black marks prompting catastrophe

When the signal symbol exploded in the sky, Scarface Cao Yong was sulking in the cave.

The dignified law enforcement captain of the eighth level of Qi Refining was tricked by a mining slave.

The signal symbol exploded in the wrong direction - Song Yu was supposed to be blocking people on the other side of the mountain, so why did the fireworks explode from that position?

Unless Song Yu is dead, the signal talisman was placed by the mine slave.

"Damn it!"

Cao Yong punched the stone wall, "That kid is hunting back!"

He himself felt ridiculous when he said this.

Why would a mining slave with no cultivation level hunt down regular disciples of the Qingyun Sect?

But Han Tie is dead, Zhao Hu is dead, Ta Xue is disabled, and now Song Yu is dead too.

He couldn't tolerate disbelief.

Cao Yong forced himself to calm down.

Song Yu's six-layer body-protecting aura of refining qi is not too thick. If the opponent uses poison and traps, it is indeed possible to succeed.

But since he was at the eighth level of Qi refining, his protective shield was at least 50% thicker than Song Yu's, so even if he used poison, he might not be able to break through the defense.

And judging from the previous fights, this kid used poison and traps every time he killed someone - indicating that his frontal combat power was limited and he could only rely on these side tactics.

"He is at the end of his tether now."

Cao Yong encouraged himself, "It must have taken a lot of effort to kill Song Yu.

As long as I don't get poisoned and don't step on traps, he's just useless."

He picked up the knife and walked out of the cave towards the direction where the signal talisman exploded. He walked very slowly, taking every step with extreme caution, holding an antidote pill in his mouth. He carefully checked every abnormality on the ground, and first cut the vines on the branches to test.

But what he didn't know was that Su Yu had no intention of using traps to deal with him.

Su Yu stood on the crown of a towering ancient tree, watching Cao Yong approach from a high position.

The frost sword in his hand glowed coldly under the moonlight, and he had the Pyroblast Talisman in his arms.

The Frost Sword alone cannot break Cao Yong's body-protecting membrane - the eight-layer Qi Refining membrane is more than twice as thick as Han Tie's.

In the past, killing Han Tie at the fourth level of Qi Refining required four consecutive cuts. Cao Yong's Gangmiao required at least seven or eight cuts, and his breath could never be used to cut that many cuts.

But he had an idea.

The power of the Pyroblast Talisman is equivalent to a full blow in the middle stage of Qi Refining. If it is attached to the end of the hilt of the Frost Sword and detonated - the impact of the flames will push the Frost Sword out like a crossbow arrow, and its penetrating power is far better than a bare-handed stab.

Detonating in absolute stillness, the sword tip was aimed at the weakest point of Cao Yonggang's membrane and penetrated with one blow.

This is what his father taught him - Orion's arrows rely on the power of the bow string, and their penetrating power is ten times better than throwing it with bare hands.

The Pyroblast Talisman is his bowstring, and the Frost Sword is his arrow.

But there was a fatal flaw in this idea: he would have to hold the sword when the pyroblast exploded, and the blast of fire would also damage him.

He needs a time shield - but that will consume thirty breaths of life and a black mark.

Five realms turned into six realms, and he hesitated.

Or he can use the time stop to precisely control the timing of the explosion within a very small range, and let go of his hand at the moment the Pyroblast talisman explodes, so that the impact force only acts on the hilt of the sword.

But this requires extremely high precision, and he is only 50% sure.

Six paths are six paths.

Now there is no need to wait for Cao Yong to call more fellow disciples, there is no chance to use it.

Cao Yong walked to a relatively open clearing in the forest and stopped and looked around, spreading his consciousness.

"Come out!

Didn't you put the signal sign just to attract me?

Now that I'm here, you're hiding?"

Su Yu smiled silently on the tree crown.

He was waiting for the chance to kill with one strike.

Cao Yong was pacing back and forth in the open space more and more irritably.

Su Yu held the Frost Sword tightly and took out the Pyroblast Talisman from his arms.

He didn't attach the talisman to the hilt of the sword - that way the impact would be scattered when it exploded.
